Your admissions journey

From Studielink to your first day at the Maastricht Science Programme. This page walks you through the steps; you apply through Studielink. Tap a step to open the link, see a sample letter, or watch the welcome video.

Step1

Initial steps and general verification

Student Services Centre
Register at Studielink
Create your account and submit the initial application. Studielink opens on 1 October 2026.
Open Studielink ↗
MyApplication portal: admission tasks
  • Upload your diploma or grades transcript
  • Authorise document verification
  • Upload your passport or ID
  • Upload your motivation letter
  • Prove your English language proficiency
Log in to the portal ↗

Maastricht Science Programme · Open Day 14 November 2026
Sample letter · Student Services Centre Subject: Conditional admission letter - Complete your application to participate in the selection process

Dear Applicant,

We have assessed the diploma/grades transcript you have submitted. Based on this, we are happy to let you know that you meet the prior education requirements for the study programme B Liberal Arts and Sciences (MSP), on the condition that you have obtained (or will obtain on time) the required diploma/additional requirements.

Important!
If you do not meet the admission requirements, you cannot start your study programme at Maastricht University.

Selective study programme

The study programme B Liberal Arts and Sciences (MSP) is a selective programme. This means you need to complete the selection process to assess whether you can be admitted.

Complete your open admissions tasks

Please make sure you complete all of your open admission tasks so that we can assess your application.

Sample letter · MSP Board of Admissions Subject: Enrolment & your UM email account, congratulations you're almost there!

Dear Applicant,

Congratulations!
Based on your participation in the selection process we are happy to offer you a place in the study programme B Liberal Arts and Sciences (MSP) at Maastricht University (UM).

Enrolment tasks

Before you can start your studies, you still need to arrange some practical matters to enrol. These enrolment tasks are now available in your task list.

Your UM email account

Please check your UM email inbox regularly for information about the introduction programme and faculty updates.

MSP motivation letter The form your motivation letter is written in

Your motivation letter is written in this form. Together with your previous academic performance, it is a very important part of the admissions process and the starting point for your interview. These are the questions it asks.
